hero.title: Concrete, steam, and single-origin clarity.
hero.subtitle: Inspired by Tokyo stand-bars and Nordic light roasts. Every cup is weighed to the tenth of a gram and served without noise.
hero.featuredNote: Current hopper: Ethiopia Yirgacheffe Worka — washed bergamot & white peach.

precision.title: Gravimetric Extraction
precision.body: Every espresso shot and hand-pour is brewed by ratio, water mineral profile, and temperature curve.

space.title: Monochrome Calm
space.body: Raw concrete counters, stainless steel, and unhurried acoustics designed for fifteen minutes of focus.

sourcing.title: Micro-Lot Transparency
sourcing.body: Seasonal small-holder harvests roasted ultra-clean to preserve terroir over roast character.

menu.heading: Bar Menu
menu.lead: Concise daily offerings. All milk beverages are steamed with barista oat milk by default; organic dairy is available on request.

hand_pour.title: V60 Single-Origin Pour
hand_pour.description: Hand-brewed filter coffee to order from our rotating micro-lot shelf. Served in a carafe with a preheated tasting glass.

double_espresso.title: Double Espresso
double_espresso.description: 18g in, 40g out. Bright acidity, syrupy body, and a clean floral finish.

oat_cortado.title: Tokyo Cortado
oat_cortado.description: Equal parts double ristretto and micro-textured oat milk served in a 120ml tempered glass.

cold_brew_tonic.title: Yuzu Espresso Tonic
cold_brew_tonic.description: Chilled washed-lot espresso layered over dry botanical tonic water and aromatic Kochi yuzu peel.

ceremonial_matcha.title: Uji Ceremonial Usucha
ceremonial_matcha.description: First-harvest stone-milled Uji matcha whisked to order with 78°C soft spring water.

hojicha_latte.title: Roasted Hojicha Latte
hojicha_latte.description: Charcoal-roasted Kyoto green tea stems steamed with silky oat milk. Naturally low in caffeine with smoky cacao notes.

black_sesame_financier.title: Black Sesame Financier
black_sesame_financier.description: Crisp-edged toasted almond and black sesame cake baked fresh each morning.

cardamom_knot.title: Crushed Cardamom Knot
cardamom_knot.description: Nordic sourdough brioche laminated with freshly mortar-ground green cardamom pods and pearl sugar.

about.heading: Philosophy & Roast
about.lead: Kitsi strips the coffee house down to two essentials: raw agricultural excellence and disciplined extraction.
about.storyP1: Founded after years studying Tokyo's six-seat kissaten and Nordic micro-roasteries, Kitsi was built as an antidote to cluttered menus and over-syruped drinks.
about.storyP2: Our counter is a continuous slab of cast concrete and brushed steel—no barriers between the grinder, the brewer, and the guest.
about.lotsLead: Available as filter pours at the bar or in 250g whole-bean tins.

huila.name: Finca El Diviso
huila.notes: Red currant, panela, roasted cacao nib

uji.name: Samidori First Flush
uji.notes: Sweet nori, steamed edamame, lingering umami

visit.heading: Visit the Bar
visit.lead: No reservations. Walk in, take a seat at the concrete bar, or carry out.

punavuori.name: Kitsi 01 — Flagship Espresso Bar
punavuori.note: Full pour-over bar, retail bean shelf, and 14 concrete bench seats.

grunerlokka.name: Kitsi 02 — Stand Bar
grunerlokka.note: Express standing espresso bar and Uji matcha counter.
